title: agent(prompt, { stallMs }) sets that agent's stall window: one quiet for longer fails, one given more time replies
notes: Claude Code documents stallMs as one agent's stall window in milliseconds. ODW starts a stalled agent again `stallRestarts` times (default 1) before the call throws with reason "stalled"; the script sees the same rejection either way. By hand on Claude Code, the 'quiet' agent has to stay silent some other way (a model cannot be told to).
